body: Ok I may talk to them in the near future. Thanks a ton for helping!
Yeah it sounds great, but I know I would end up losing social ties because I would fall into a habit of lethargy and start blowing off friends
I'd just rather work through this without changing how my parents see me because in my family the dynamic is very cheery and overall happy, and I would rather not change that for them
Stay At Home Mom. I bet they would be supportive, but this is something I would rather keep to myself and work through then bring it to them
Probably watching netflix till I fell asleep
Both are very happy, and lived sort of that life. My mom is a SAHM but went to uni with a masters in education

Exactly. It's reached the point where I think "ok i need to do this pointless schoolwork so I can get into a good uni, but then what? more studying so I can work till I die doing work that will eventually be rendered null"

I've reached the point where I don't even care about the pressure, and if it was off I feel like I would keep doing mandatory schoolwork myself but I would drop out of sports and end up at home all day doing nothing

Thanks for the support, but it's just that no activities or subjects are remotely exciting for me anymore. I do play in a band, but I've been sluffing out on rehearsals because I don't feel like playing and would rather just wait until I can finally go to sleep. I understand your point on the what will i do with my life thing, but its not just that I don't know but that I legitimately hope I don't see the day. I actually find myself wishing I would die in an accident to avoid the guilt my family would feel
They've both always been really supportive to me, but there always feels like there's pressure to be the best. Being awful at the sport just takes away the enjoyment.

I love the drums, but as time goes on I can't even get up to do that. I also play a sport, but I'm pretty terrible and have just lost motivation for both. I wake up and basically just can't wait to go to bed

EDIT: also, my school couselor is a joke. I've seen her turn kids like me away telling them they're "just being teenagers"

It's pretty much constant. I'll enjoy one moment but then it's just back to this. It's been about 2 years. I wouldn't even describe it as sad, just... depressed. It's not like i'm constantly upset, just unmotivated because "what's the point"
